itemList.description:
Providing and laying 100mm thick pre-cast cover slabs over drains & 
Rain pit of width not exceeding 800 mm using M20 concrete reinforced 
with Micro Alloyed High carbon steel with 3mm - 3ply wired steel @ 2.00 
kg/m2, slabs jointed in CM 1:3 proportion and nicely finished Including 
providing holes in the Cover slabs wherever necessary for easy 
drainage of surface water including of labour, materials, scaffolding, 
usage of machinery, curing, lead and lift charges etc, Complete
